speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
text: asked the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (a) whether the appointments of grassroot adviser (GRA) cease from the day the Writ of Election is issued to the day after the results of the General Election are announced; and (b) if not, whether GRAs can continue writing appeal letters to Government agencies on behalf of residents during this period.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: They help the PA with its mission to foster social cohesion and also connect with and engage people on Government policies and schemes.

speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
text: Can I clarify with the Minister what he means when he says members of public.

speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
text: Does that include the Members of Parliament as well or the former Members of Parliament, who are now members of public after the Writ of Election is issued?

speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
text: And so, they are no longer Members of Parliament.
